reviewer: breadth-lane worker (gen 6, vision) — verify-first probe + route-complete validator in headless Chromium

rubric.evidence: Verify-first probe (headless chromium, --disable-gpu, CPU/XNNPACK) BEFORE any build: @mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.18 + official deeplab_v3.tflite returned a real 640×640 category mask with classes {0 background, 15 person} out of a 21-label map [background,aeroplane,…,person,…,tv] plus 21 confidence masks on the bundled portrait; selfie_multiclass_256x256 also probed OK (6 classes). Route validator then drove real segment() on all 4 routes × desktop+mobile (18/18 checks).
rubric.notes: No canned output anywhere; every rung calls SegmenterWorkerClient.segmentImage → worker → ImageSegmenter.segment.

rubric.evidence: Worker returns {width, height, mask: Uint8Array category index per pixel, hist per class, conf per class from the model's confidence masks, labels from segmenter.getLabels()}; overview see-inside table shows per-class pixels/coverage/mean-confidence computed from exactly those arrays (validator: ≥2 rows, iPx numeric).
rubric.notes: Semantic sanity: portrait sample → person class dominates foreground; dog sample → dog.

rubric.evidence: MODEL_URL is the literal official bundle https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/image_segmenter/deeplab_v3/float32/1/deeplab_v3.tflite (2.78MB) at the segment.js loader call site; tasks-vision pinned 0.10.18 (same as lib/mediapipe.js); delegate honestly probed (requestAdapter) and reported in the readout (CPU in headless).
rubric.notes: Classic worker like the 5 built MediaPipe demos (FilesetResolver needs importScripts) — the documented hard exception.

rubric.evidence: All 4 routes use createModelLoader({model:{modelId: MODEL_URL, runtime:'mediapipe', sizeMB:2.8}}) — first visit shows Download; the validator's persistent profile downloads once and later cells auto-init from cache (ensureReady only clicks Download when offered).
rubric.notes: Clear-cache/update states come from the shared loader unchanged.

rubric.evidence: Progress/status via the shared loader + #status role=status aria-live; segmentation errors surface on the page ('Segmentation failed: …' .status.err); practical has an explicit no-person state (validator checks noPerson hidden on success).
rubric.notes: Offline-after-cache works via the site SW like the other MediaPipe demos.

rubric.evidence: Every visible control driven by the validator: Run (real inference), view-mode segmented control (aria-pressed toggles Overlay/Mask/Cutout), opacity range (80% live value), sample thumbs (click+keyboard Enter/Space), dropzone (click+keyboard), legend spotlight chips (aria-pressed), preview backdrop colour input, Download PNG (enabled only after cutout).
rubric.notes: All buttons labelled; canvas has aria-label pointing at the textual legend; slider wrapped in <label> with live value span.

rubric.evidence: Mask, legend, confidence numbers and cutouts are all derived from the returned category/confidence masks in-page; failure path (no person / segment error) shows an honest message, never a canned mask.

role=status aria-live status regions on all routes; focus-visible outlines (SEGMENT_CSS); aria-pressed on toggle controls; keyboard operability on thumbs/dropzone/chips; legend duplicates canvas content as text (expose-canvas-content-to-browser-features).
rubric.notes: Colour is never the only channel — chips carry name + coverage + confidence text.

rubric.evidence: Validator exercises all 4 routes at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3 with zero failing checks; sample strips wrap; canvas scales inline-size:100%; seg-view/field-row wrap on narrow.
rubric.notes: No horizontal overflow observed in the mobile cells.

rubric.evidence: Inference + per-class confidence reduction run in the worker (bitmap transferred in); main thread only colorizes the ≤640² category mask (one typed-array pass) and paints — probe measured segment() at ~0ms reported wall time after warm start on CPU.
rubric.notes: Same architecture as the 5 built MediaPipe demos (documented hard exception family); mask-resolution composite keeps the dense-output cost bounded.

guidanceConsulted.query: canvas image overlay visualization with accessible controls
guidanceConsulted.applied: Canvas carries aria-label + tabindex and every mask readout is duplicated as text (legend chips, per-class table); the wild rung's spotlight follows the interactive-content-reveal pattern with a legend-driven (not pointer-only) reveal.

guidanceConsulted.query: segmented control toggle group keyboard accessibility
guidanceConsulted.applied: View-mode group uses real <button>s with aria-pressed in a role=group; legend spotlight chips are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; all keyboard-focusable with visible focus.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input label live region accessibility
guidanceConsulted.applied: Opacity slider is a native <input type=range> wrapped in <label> with an aria-live value readout and accent-color styling (no custom control replacement).

openQuestions: GPU delegate path (WebGL) not exercised in headless — delegate readout is CPU; spot-check on a GPU device.
VIDEO running mode (live webcam segmentation) left out of this wave; overview is still-image only.
